player_prompt.intro:
E te Player {player_id} i Nim.
O lou faamoemoe o le ave le mea mulimuli e toe.
I luga o tagata taalo uma, filifili mai pile e tasi ma ave ese mea se isi pe sili atu.
Faaaoga le faaupuga '[pile quantity]', lea e faasino i le suafa o pile ma le numera o mea e aveesea.
Mo se faatauga, '[0 3]' e aveese mea e 3 mai pile 0.

invalid_move.wrong_format: E leai se faatulagaga talafeagai o le siitiaina na maua. Faaaoga '[pile quantity]'.
invalid_move.correct_format_wrong_fields: Player {player_id}, Mau faiaiga leaga. Kolone {col} ua osofaia.
invalid_move.out_of_range: O le faasino igoa o faaputuga {pile_index} ua i fafo atu.
invalid_move.non_positive: E tatau ona aveese le itiiti ifo i se mea e tasi.
invalid_move.exceeds_pile: E le mafai ona aveese {quantity} mai i le faaputuga o {pile_index} (naʻo {pile_count} e totoe).

observation.removed_from_piles: Player {player_id} played [{pile_index} {quantity}], removing {quantity} object(s) from pile {pile_index}.

outcome.win: O le tagata taalo {player_id} na ia aveina mea mulimuli ((s)!
